newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen Benelux interim net up 9.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen Benelux interim net up 9.6 pct.

text.p: Floppy disk maker Shenzhen Benelux Enterprise Co Ltd said on Wednesday its interim net earnings for 1996 climbed 9.63 percent year-on-year to 4.78 million yuan.
In an interim report published in the Shenzhen Securities Times, Benelux said main operating income reached 117.58 million yuan against 118.43 million yuan in the first half of 1995.
The firm did not say whether the report had been compiled under Chinese or international accounting standards.
Benelux said its earnings growth was based on the steady sale of its core product, the 3.5-inch floppy disk and other computer-related components. It did not give further details.
In its annual report last year, the company said net earnings had fallen 30.8 percent from the previous year's level of 13.73 million yuan to 9.50 million yuan in 1995.
Its earnings slide was triggered by increased competition in the market from overseas counterparts, which forced it to lower the price of some products, cutting into profit margins.
The company said sales of its 3.5-inch disks accounted for more than 70 percent of main operating income in 1995.
